Exhaustive streaming classification of all 27,730,498 coordinates in RUN_2026-07-27_20-33-10/63-magic-drc: 27,730,498/27,730,498 = 100.0000% lie inside the 10 sky130_sram_1kbyte_1rw1r_32x256_8 footprints; 0 in the routing channel, 0 in the standard-cell logic zone (max y = 907.87um; logic zone starts at 917.5um). SoC/CPU asymmetry explained: SoC declares the CPU as a hard MACROS entry with MAGIC_DRC_USE_GDS=false, so read_macro_lef loads the LEF abstract and Magic never touches SRAM-internal geometry — its 9,081 errors are a disjoint set (9,049 nwell.4 + 32 met4.4a), the already-documented DEF+LEF-abstract artifact class, not a diluted CPU flood. KLayout=0 on identical GDS because sky130A_mr.drc has explicit hierarchy-aware SRAM_EXCLUDE (select("-*sky130_sram_*kbyte_*") off nsdm/psdm/nwell, grouping the SRAM with I/O pad cells as a pre-verified macro) plus a working areaid:ce two-tier li1 scope — the relief Magic's COREID/coreli attempts but fails to deliver for this OpenRAM macro. Root cause: Magic's flat drc(full) engine cannot validate this dense custom OpenRAM macro's internals, independent of read path. Stage-1 sign-off stands on KLayout DRC=0 + Netgen LVS MATCH + DRT 0. Adopted run 3 (RUN_2026-07-30_06-42-17) as the Stage-2 result; antenna 140/120 accepted as a quantified residual. Six-run campaign established the trade-off is BINARY and not tunable: Odb.HeuristicDiodeInsertion cuts antenna to 40-90 but costs ~0.5 ns of clock-root latency and breaks hold at 5/9 corners, because the step re-legalizes placement and re-routes globally (fuzzydiodeplacement -> detailedplacement -> globalrouting) regardless of how many diodes it inserts. Latency is binary on whether the step runs: off = 0.87-0.93 ns, on = 1.38-1.44 ns across a 234k-272k cell-count spread. Three tuning levers all failed identically (DIODE_ON_PORTS none; clock-net exclusion patch achieving zero CLOCK-sigtype diodes; threshold 800 giving 5.6x fewer diodes) because each reduces WHAT is inserted, not whether the pass runs. Run 3 final: LVS PASSED, routing DRC 0, PDN 0, hold 0 at all 9 corners, antenna 140/120, KLayout 4 + Magic 9081 (settled waivers), 44.1 mW, 37.9% util. Untried lever recorded not pursued: GRT repair does not trigger the legalization sub-steps, so pushing GRT_ANTENNA_ITERS/MARGIN beyond 8/25 could improve antenna without the hold cost (expect incremental — 8/25 already gave 140/120). Full evidence in memory/pd/knowledge.md; LibreLane clock-net patch retained at memory/pd/patches/ (harmless, default-off elsewhere).
